verdict: Separate post-hoc paired occupied-heap reporting is supported for this fixed workload. The original absolute quiet-window qualification remains failed.

pairedMethod.trialModeOrder: Rotated baseline/public/secret over fresh canisters, one identical Wasm.
pairedMethod.matching: Exact trial, retained/dropped stage and GC snapshot label. All 24 GC indices checked, not only the tail.
pairedMethod.queries: Snapshot and verification use read/query; their transient allocations do not commit.
pairedMethod.controls: Both root arrays, canonical inputs, fixture, pressure messages and 24 GC trigger calls are shared across modes; dropping preserves array capacities.

counterReconciliation.afterDrop: Each mode reclaims its entire extra allocation relative to baseline; additional occupied heap is zero at every matched GC index.

commonDrift.sourceReason: Each mark stack table requests size 8184 plus 24-byte Blob header. The weak registry additionally uses a 16-byte MarkStack holder plus 24-byte header, initialized by complete_marking even without user Weak. Ranking 128 partitions uses 1024-byte payload plus 24-byte header. Forced GC replies without Candid allocation, and the current allocation partition is excluded from evacuation, allowing collector garbage to accumulate.
commonDrift.cacheHeaderMatch: Each observed per-key increment equals its fixed 20576/28800-byte payload plus 24-byte Blob header.

limitations: Post-hoc analysis of the unchanged frozen run, not a rerun or a pass of the original protocol.
Observed paired occupied heap and recovery in this workload, not universal exact live-memory sizes.
No authoritative GC-phase/completion claim and no secure secret-erasure claim.
Identical paired drift is measured and accounted for here; unrelated workloads need their own matched controls.
changes: No actor, runtime, SDK, runner, thresholds or original raw evidence were changed; no measurement was rerun.
